verdict.rationale: Mistral documents `bbox_annotation` for bboxes the OCR model extracts around charts and figures, and lets users ask it to describe or caption each figure. Per-page `blocks` arrays carry bounding boxes and structural labels, and community testers confirm embedded images come back with coordinates. One hands-on report says a whole page was detected as a single image with full-page coordinates, which points to limits in figure segmentation accuracy rather than a missing capability. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the image-crop output format and coordinate schema for figures, and independent corroboration that figure detection and VLM descriptions are reliable at figure-level granularity.
